page.overview:
Who is Isaac?

is a major character in Out of Stock, the third story in Fazbear Frights 2: Fetch. He's one of Oscar's loyal friends who sticks by his side even after he takes the Plushtrap Chaser.

Not much is said about Isaac's appearance other than that he's short. In the graphic novel, he has blond hair covered by a black beanie, blue eyes, and a pointy nose.

Isaac is a very loyal friend, sticking by Oscar’s side even when he gets them into trouble or has to cancel plans. He's very understanding of Oscar’s financial situation and is willing to share with him. Despite Isaac's occasional teasing and playfully smug remarks, he tends to be less courageous than Oscar and Raj.

Isaac had met Raj and Oscar on the playground in third grade, and they've been best friends ever since. He is very understanding of Oscar's different financial situation. Isaac and Raj always change their plans and try to include Oscar whenever they can. At home, Isaac has to care for his younger brother Jordan until his mom gets home from work at three o'clock. He likes to spend his free time spending his allowance at the mall with Raj and hanging out with Oscar.
